passage.label: Say I am only a warner and there is no deity except Allah the One the Prevailing, Lord of heavens earth and between them the Exalted in Might the Perpetual Forgiver; say it is great news from which you turn away; no knowledge of the exalted assembly when they disputed, only revelation that I am a clear warner; the Lord telling the angels He will create a human from clay, and when proportioned and breathed into of His soul to fall in prostration; the angels prostrating all entirely except Iblees who was arrogant and became of the disbelievers; the question what prevented prostration to what was created with My hands, arrogance or haughtiness; his claim of fire over clay; expulsion from Paradise and curse until the Day of Recompense; the reprieve request until resurrection granted until the Day of the time well-known; his oath by divine might to mislead all except the chosen servants; the truth-oath that Hell will be filled with him and his followers together; no payment asked for the Quran and no pretension; it is but a reminder to the worlds and its information will be known after a time

arabicExcerpts.text: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٞۖ وَمَا مِنۡ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ
رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّـٰرُ
قُلۡ هُوَ نَبَؤٌاْ عَظِيمٌ
أَنتُمۡ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضُونَ
مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنۡ عِلۡمِۭ بِٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰٓ إِذۡ يَخۡتَصِمُونَ
إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ
إِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرٗا مِّن طِينٖ
فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ
إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسۡجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقۡتُ بِيَدَيَّۖ أَسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ أَمۡ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَالِينَ
قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡهُ خَلَقۡتَنِي مِن نَّارٖ وَخَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن طِينٖ
قَالَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٞ
وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ لَعۡنَتِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنظَرِينَ
إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡوَقۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡلُومِ
قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
قَالَ فَٱلۡحَقُّ وَٱلۡحَقَّ أَقُولُ
لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعۡدَ حِينِۭ

mainSubject.label: The Prophet's self-definition as warner only, paired with the confession of Allah as One and Prevailing, Lord of the cosmos, Mighty and Perpetually Forgiving; the message named great news turned away from; his disclaimer of independent knowledge of the angelic assembly, receiving only the warner commission; the creation announcement to the angels with the prostration command after proportioning and in-breathing; universal angelic prostration with Iblees excepted through arrogance; the interrogation of his refusal and his fire-over-clay claim; expulsion and curse to the Day of Recompense; reprieve granted to a known appointed day; his oath to mislead all but the chosen servants answered by the divine truth-oath filling Hell with him and his followers; closing disavowal of payment and pretension, the Quran as reminder to the worlds whose news will be verified after a time

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Say: I do not ask you any payment for the Quran, and I am not of the pretentious.

notes: Wave 6 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 ends at the punishment-hastening demand (16) before the patience command opens the Dawud block (17); P2 closes with the blessed-Book reflection verse (29); P3 groups the Sulayman, Ayyub and patriarch remembrance sequence (30-48); P4 is the two-returns contrast ending with the Fire quarrel (49-64); P5 begins with the warner-only declaration and runs through the Adam-Iblees narrative to the closing reminder (65-88).
